elements.label: Figure 3.10
elements.description: Grouped bar chart. Y-axis: "Annual income (VND, millions)" (as printed), scale 0 to 100. Series: Wage, bonus, and severance (teal); Family business (orange); Agriculture (grey). Categories are paired 2010 and 2020 bars for each region: Midlands & Northern Mountains; Red River Delta; Northern & Coastal Central Region; Central Highlands; Southeast; Mekong Delta. No values are printed; approximate readings: Midlands & Northern Mountains 2010: Wage ~56, Family business ~29, Agriculture ~87; 2020: Wage ~67, Family business ~26, Agriculture ~80. Red River Delta 2010: Wage ~65, Family business ~37, Agriculture ~68; 2020: Wage ~71, Family business ~32, Agriculture ~44. Northern & Coastal Central Region 2010: Wage ~63, Family business ~34, Agriculture ~76; 2020: Wage ~69, Family business ~34, Agriculture ~63. Central Highlands 2010: Wage ~67, Family business ~28, Agriculture ~80; 2020: Wage ~63, Family business ~25, Agriculture ~70. Southeast 2010: Wage ~71, Family business ~38, Agriculture ~25; 2020: Wage ~77, Family business ~33, Agriculture ~14. Mekong Delta 2010: Wage ~62, Family business ~37, Agriculture ~70; 2020: Wage ~67, Family business ~35, Agriculture ~57. Note printed under chart: "Household-level income." Source: World Bank staff calculations using VHLSS 2010, 2020. Pattern: agriculture is the most common source in the mountainous and Red River regions in 2010, wage income is high and rising across regions by 2020, and agriculture falls sharply in the Southeast.

elements.label: Figure 3.11
elements.description: Grouped bar chart. Y-axis: "Annual income (VND, millions)" (as printed), scale 0 to 250. Series: Wage, bonus, and severance (teal); Family business (orange); Agriculture (grey). Categories are paired 2010 and 2020 bars for each region: Midlands & Northern Mountains; Red River Delta; Northern & Coastal Central Region; Central Highlands; Southeast; Mekong Delta. No values are printed; approximate readings: Midlands & Northern Mountains 2010: Wage ~28, Family business ~23, Agriculture ~31; 2020: Wage ~95, Family business ~85, Agriculture ~46. Red River Delta 2010: Wage ~51, Family business ~51, Agriculture ~24; 2020: Wage ~167, Family business ~176, Agriculture ~34. Northern & Coastal Central Region 2010: Wage ~32, Family business ~37, Agriculture ~25; 2020: Wage ~105, Family business ~111, Agriculture ~28. Central Highlands 2010: Wage ~25, Family business ~39, Agriculture ~35; 2020: Wage ~79, Family business ~123, Agriculture ~51. Southeast 2010: Wage ~75, Family business ~80, Agriculture ~27; 2020: Wage ~200, Family business ~197, Agriculture ~13. Mekong Delta 2010: Wage ~32, Family business ~40, Agriculture ~43; 2020: Wage ~108, Family business ~119, Agriculture ~47. Note printed under chart: "Annual nominal household level income." Source: World Bank staff calculations using VHLSS 2010, 2020. Pattern: incomes rise strongly in nearly all regions from 2010 to 2020, with the Southeast and Red River Delta highest in 2020 and the Midlands & Northern Mountains lowest.
